notes.title: Overruled! Full release!
notes.content:
Brawlers!

It’s been an awesome journey through Early Access and we are really excited to announce that we have finally reached the destination of a full release! Thanks to all those of you who have been playing our game and supporting us through Early Access, we hope you have enjoyed it thus far and will continue to do so for some time. We have released an update for the final release candidate, the details of which we will post shortly. See below for a final feature list of the main release. 

Here’s a list of features for the game:
9 Mayhem-filled multiplayer maps 
9 Characters each with their own unique VO 
7 Game Types from Invasion to Race to Headhunter 
Over 30 different rules to change with thousands of ways to play 
54 Single Player Challenge Maps 
Local Multiplayer 
Online Multiplayer 
Steam Achievements & Leaderboards 
Tweakable pre-game options 
OST - Digital version of soundtrack

To celebrate the full release we're offering a 40% discount. It's the perfect time to get your friends invovled (so you can beat them!)

Thanks again to all those that have supported us through Early Access and welcome to the new Brawlers that are joining us going forward.

We’ll see you in the game and the forums!

notes.title: Overruled! Update - NEW CARDS! NEW CAMPAIGNS! NEW LEVELS!
notes.content:
BRAWLERS!
It’s time for the first Overruled! update of 2015. Our bodies are ready. Your bodies are ready. Let’s do this.

New Cards

Lend a Hand
This card is all about sharing. Force your opponent to help you out by swapping your cards for theirs! How lovely of them. Best played when you have no cards and everyone else has lots – share the wealth right?! If more than 2 players are in the match – everyone swaps! 

Super Overrule
What’s better than Overruled? SUPER OVERRULE. Why? Because it’s super, duh. 

When played, this card not only cancels the card that your opponent is playing – it also takes that card from them and adds it to your deck. Opponent  trying to disable melee when you're on fire? Super Overrule it, steal their card, set them on fire then disable melee! Delicious justice.  Best followed up with a swift kick to the teeth for added insult.




Single Player
Two new single player characters now have their full set of challenges available! Were Wanda and Anti Hero now have 6 challenges each, so that's more scores for you to beat. Anti Hero probably has a slightly harder set of challenges than Were Wanda, so get ready to test yourself.


Multiplayer
Brawlers; there’s no better place for a brawl than a back-alley. Anti-Hero knows this well, and his level is now available to play in multiplayer! 


Multiplayer Playlists
Our shiny new playlist system has had a lot of love, so we’ve given it a lot of love too. 2 new playlists for you to try!


Crazy Assassins
Like living life on the edge? With 1 second ranged cooldowns? 1 second respawns? And 1 health? YOU DO? This one is for you, ya loonatic.

What The?!?
A playlist designed to make you more confused and horrified than a piglet at a tiger parade. The game mode changes every 5 seconds. Can you keep up? Can you score points? Can we weep softly into your hands until the game ends? This one is for you. 



That's it for this update then guys - let us know what you think, Steam forums are always open for feedback, and you can always find us on our blog and twitter too.  

We'll see you in game and on the forums!

notes.title: ANOTHER New Overruled! Content Update!
notes.content:
Greetings, Brawlers!

A new update for Overruled! is now available, packing EVEN MORE punches. Read on for the juicy details:

New Features

- A new change 'em up has been added! The latest card will pick one of your opponents cards and play it for you. It's basic thievery, but we've decided to take a positive spin on things and call it the "Helpful" card.

- A whole new single player campaign has been added! "Sasol's Pillage" will take you on an ♥♥♥-kicking piratey adventure, all voiced by the excellent Miss Mousie Mouse.

-  Single player has been given leaderboards too! See how your score fares against other brawlers across campaigns and individual levels.

- 5 new single player achievements have been added, it's up to you to find them!

Pure content in the latest update, we hope you like it. As with every Early Access update, be sure to tell us about any problems you encounter so that we can get them fixed!

Much love,

MT17

notes.title: Overruled! Invasion Update - New Game Mode! Tweakables!
notes.content:
Brawlers!

It's time for another Overruled! update - and this one is packing some sweet new punches. 

Invasion Mode
Invasion is the first gametype we’ve released since early access. It’s the perfect balance of attack and defend. If you want to go all out attack, you can. Happy to sit back and claim a little corner of the map as yours? That’s fine too. So… What is invasion?

When invasion ticks around, three neutral bases spawn on the map. If you run and stand in a base, it’ll slowly turn your colour, and you’ll have claimed it after a few seconds. Once it’s yours – and you’ll know when it is – it’ll earn you points every second!

You can claim as many bases as you want – as long as other players let you. If you hold two bases, you’ll get 2 times the current points value. All three bases and you’ll be surging to the lead in no time.

But what makes it so difficult? Well, if any other player happens to stand in your base, it’ll get turned back to neutral… and then they can claim it for themselves. So it’s up to you – grab hold of one base and defend it from every one else? Or go all out offensive and claim as many as you can? Or maybe you’re in the lead already, and you just want to run around annoying everyone else by stopping them from getting bases. It’s up to you.

Pre-Game Options

Tweakables! 

Before a game starts, you’ve now got a whole bunch of options as what the game is that you’re going to be playing. These options include things like what game types are included, how long a game type is, what cards you’ll get, how much health you’ve got… and it makes each game feel completely different. The host can set this before you start playing.

We're not going to go into too much detail here, but you should tell us about the crazy game types you've set up in the comments below! You can find our faves here.

Full Change Log

For the curious, here's a list of all the changes in this week's update:

Features
FEATURE: New game mode "Invasion"
FEATURE: Pre-game options (Tweakable general options, cyclable presets)
FEATURE: New multiplayer results screen
FEATURE: New single player results screen
FEATURE: Extra 20 hints and tips on loading screen
FEATURE: New style change em ups

Tweaks
TWEAK: Change to jump to make it easier to double jump off the edge of a platform
TWEAK: Balance pass on all SP campaigns for trophy boundaries
TWEAK: Consistency pass on loading screen text
TWEAK: All levels with floors flat on ground has been raised

Bug Fixes
BUG: Neapolitan's censor bar follows him properly on loading screen
BUG: Neapolitan's censor bar falls off when dying on back
BUG: Players are immune to melee attacks whilst charging a melee
BUG: AI falling through bunny test 1
BUG: Hall of just-ish icon updated
BUG: Motherlover clips camera with head during loading
BUG: If a helpful card plays another helpful card
BUG: Black bar scaling issues
BUG: Veteran achievement doesn't unlock
BUG: Possible to fit through gaps protecting enemies in trolls turmoil 2
BUG: Crowns aren't always in the same place at start of level
BUG: Icons for card cycle keys appear darker for keyboard
BUG: Cards do not re-arrange properly
BUG: Punches not always connecting

Enjoy - and let us know what you think in the comments below.

Love,

AJ, MT17 and everyone at Dlala Studios / Team17

notes.title: Update Incoming - Important Info for Brawlers
notes.content:
Brawlers!

An update for Overruled! is coming tomorrow packed with new stuff. We will, of course, share the full details with you when it goes live - but right now we need to give you an important heads up.

As of the next update, your existing save game files will no longer work with the latest builds of Overruled! due to key changes to the way your save data is managed by the game. We know that this can be frustrating, even in Early Access, which is why we're letting you know now. 

Stay glued to the forum tomorrow for full details of the update!

MT17

notes.title: This Week - New Update and Play The Devs
notes.content:
Hey Guys,

We just want to apologise for being a bit quiet on the forums and on the update front for the last few weeks. We've had our heads down working on some great content and we've also had a couple of awesome expos (EGX and PlayExpo) and it's made us neglect our community. To be honest that's not a good enough excuse and we want you to know that you are our top priority and that everything we've been doing is to give you guys a better experience with Overruled!

We're excited to bring you the next update, which I think we're announcing at the start of the week, it's an awesome one and it's changed how we've viewed the game.

We've also got some more SP content lined up, some more MP maps, more cards, more game types and some surprises along the way. 

Really this announcement is an announcement for an announcement and it's also an apology. We are genuinely sorry and we're going to be a lot more active. We're going to start doing regular play the dev fight nights and we want to start arranging some tournaments as those of you coming to see us at Expos are starting to kick our asses.

Thank you for sticking with us and the game and I can't wait to see what you think of the new content!

We love you guys,

Thanks,

Dlala

notes.title: Overruled! Update 3 - More Features / Tweaks / Fixes! [25/09/2014]
notes.content:
Word up Brawlers!

Check out this update list for a whole host of features, tweaks and fixes in the latest Overruled! update!

Features

D-Pad Now Supported
Support for Azerty keyboards
Sessional win tally in lobbies
New loading screens with hints and tips
Kill/Death Spread After Each Match
Game types now shown on SP level select when level is highlighted
New loading screen /w character info
Hints and Tips on loading screen
Campaign guide at start of each SP level
Ability to return to level select from SP levels
Can now cycle through player indicators to show steam names

Tweaks

New run speed
Tweaks to jump speed/height
Players can't jump as high when holding swagbag
Melee attacks do more damage
Bigger knockbacks on attack
New effects on combat
Hitting head on platform causes player to fall down
Reduced time on the menu tweens
Sounds now played when hill moves in KOTH
Sounds now played when player enters hill in KOTH
Headhunter suicides now award last living opponent who hit player the kill
Unlocking animation added to SP level select
Extra team up card added to default deck
Points now grow faster and bigger on HUD when obtained
Character animation overhaul to make animations smoother
Removed ability to parry 3rd (Strong) hit in combo
Smoothed combat animations
Can now hear only 1 SFX when collecting race flag
Player can no longer hold 3 overrule cards at once
Audio played when switching between characters in SP character select
Players now fall after hitting head on solid platform
Players can no longer fill hand with Overrule cards
General lighting tweaks to levels and projectiles
New impact effects for combat
Crappy looking corkboard graphic removed

General Fixes

All screens tween off/on
Gametype timers now working correctly
In-game pause screen brightness now consistent
Improved pre-game loading
Improved loading on mac
Various fixes to disconnecting a controller
Game now loads without internet connection
Fixes to images in credits screen
Small fix to shadow rendering on character select
Mode lock card no longer travels to center of screen in edge cases
VO no longer plays after settings menu closed
Random SFX no longer plays at start of level
Infinite swagbags no longer possible by playing swagbag card when no-one is holding the bag
Big hand animation bug no longer appears
Dlala logo now appears on mac
Overlapping buttons on settings save prompt are gone
Player now drops swagbag if killed by environmental death boxes
Player no longer shown at spawn point just after death
Missing font references fixed
Suicides count towards death counts
All MP only achievements have that in Steam description

Multiplayer Fixes

Player no longer able to play on their own by removing controller
Buttons no longer appear through boxes on character select
Fix to certain audio not getting paused when online
No lobby found message will no longer appear in map select
Inactive player message no longer carries over to Map Select
Time out on connecting now longer hangs
Will no longer see inactive message if readied up
Troll's Turmoil V now displays correct score card

notes.title: Overruled! Community Roundup!
notes.content:
Hullo brawlers!
 
Welcome to the Overruled Community Roundup! Here's the lo-down of what's been going on here in the Steam forums and beyond, with hand-picked stories from myself and the devs at Dlala Studios. Enjoy!

Overruled! at gamescom 2014!

We took Overruled! to this year's gamescom expo in Cologne, Germany where 2 brilliant things happened:
[olist]
Microsoft announced that Overruled! will be coming to XBOX One
Loads of gamers got the chance to play the game on XBOX One for the first time, ...including IGN!
[/olist]
Even if you've no interest in consoles, this is great news for Overruled! More players = bigger community and a higher profile for the game.


Mousie Voices Sasol the Pirate!

We revealed the news this week that YouTuber Mousie is the voice of Sasol the Pirate! The first of many YouTubers to voice the game, Mousie gives us Sasol’s classic lines such as “Tharr be no rules for pirates” and “take yer time landlubber!”, and you can watch her Overruled! story here.


Thread of the Week!

Closer to home, the forums have been buzzing! You guys have been doing a great job of reporting any issues found whilst playing, please do keep that up. 

We've also had tactical discussions, suggestions on contols and (my personal favourite) the Looking for Players thread where lonely brawlers can find sparring partners for online fisticuffs. But, without a doubt, thread of the week has to go to:

The Character Megathread

The sheer madness of this discussion sets it apart. Here's some quotes to prove my point:

Bunny is pro. But Indie is "Make the girls crazy like Shaft" cool. 

you beat me to making this thread haha.

I'd love to make a character that's been attacked by bees or something and is all swollen up. Would look even cooler when he punches and his hand gets even bigger. :)

Character Idea
Maybe a narwhal?? :)) That would be fabulous 

:D

Keep the madness coming guys, it gives me a giggle - and I know the devs are loving your suggestions.


Overruled! Creations!

We’re loving the screenshots you’ve been taking and leaving for us in the community hub, keep it up – we’re using the best ones you take to promote the game!

You should probably avoid looking at this Anti-Hero gif late at night though, that stare stays with you.

We’re also in love with these War Stories posted by Overruled! Beta testers. We’re sure by now that you have some war wounds, so get fingers to keyboard and share your stories with the community!

Last but far from least this week is the first winner of Dlala Studios’ Draw a Character competition. Massive congratulations to David Hamblin for creating Fruit Punch – now in the game! You can see the original drawing and the final in-game character here. 

We’re always on the lookout for your creations, so get yer felt tips out and do us a character doodle for the Character Megathread.


Your Mates Needed!

My job during Early Access is to raise the profile of Overruled! and get more players playing. We all know this game is juicy and awesome, but we need you guys to be shouting about your experiences too! Here’s some ways you can help us out:

Follow Dlala Studios and Team17 on Twitter for Overruled! news, competitions and more
Sit your friends down on your sofa and show them the game! We’ve also got a “4 Steam keys for the price of 3” offer on for thrifty friend groups.
Write a review of Overruled! be totally open and honest, we’d love to know what you think of the game so far, and your reviews will help Steam users make informed decisions when buying the game.
Invade Reddit, plaster screenshots on Facebook and go crazy with YouTube gameplay vids. Just be sure to give us a heads up here in the forum whenever you make an Overruled! creation – we’ll help you make it famous!
Thumbs Up the Overruled! announcements, as this helps us get the game on Steam's front page and Community hub!


And finally…

Achievements!

Sasolid Crew
- Hold the Swag Bag for 21 Seconds as Sasol

Well done sir, well done.

See you in the forums!

MT17
